run.slice: warm Rust predictions/tree guard and restore

summary: Zero cache misses do not imply that a documentation edit avoids starting rustc.
checked: All twelve current-main documentation-edit samples across 0/4000 extra files restored 24 units with zero misses. Each nevertheless records dep_info_runs=24 and compiler_runs=0.

evidence.point: Each documentation-edit main-disabled sample has 24 local_hit events and summed dep_info_runs=24.
compile_before_key starts rustc until emitted dep-info, stops on a stored key, then re-enters the restore path.

closed_by: Tier 1 paired build telemetry and diagnostic traces; tier 2 production compile_before_key wiring. compiler_runs counts full compilation here, not dep-info discovery.
reopens_if: A sampled build has no dep-info run or takes a different discovery path.

run.slice: warm Rust predictions/tree guard and restore

summary: Failure of the workspace digest memo is not the dominant unchanged-build cost in this fixture.
checked: The 4000-file unchanged trace has 24 tree_memo=hit decisions and 24 validated predictions; hotpath root_digest is about 1.47 ms summed while stamp_roots is about 550.84 ms.

evidence.point: 4000-overhead-0-main-enabled-hotpath reports stamp_roots and root_digest cumulative durations.

closed_by: Tier 1 phase decisions and function timing. The required full entry stamp walk dominates the instrumented key path despite root memo hits.
reopens_if: Another workload, build-script OUT_DIR pattern or filesystem gives repeated root memo misses on unchanged builds.

run.slice: warm Rust predictions/tree guard and restore

summary: Artifact copying and restored-file hash seeding are not the dominant measured warm-path cost in this fixture.
checked: The unchanged 4000-file hotpath control sums compute_rustc_cache_key=628.71 ms, restore=36.41 ms and record_known_file_hashes=0.179 ms.

evidence.point: 4000-overhead-0-main-enabled-hotpath aggregates selected function calls across 29 wrapper reports.

closed_by: Tier 1 profiler attribution corroborated by the separate phase-only build. These are nested/parallel cumulative durations, not wall-clock savings.
reopens_if: A fixture has large artifacts, a copying filesystem, different restore modes or substantially different output cardinality.

run.slice: warm Rust predictions/tree guard and restore

summary: Profiler-enabled elapsed time is not a valid uncorrected main-versus-v1 regression estimate.
checked: Three same-seed enabled/disabled controls show median paired hotpath overhead +23.50% with zero extra docs and +12.19% with 4000 docs.

evidence.point: Both overhead comparisons contain three explicit main-enabled/main-disabled pairs and no phase tracing.

closed_by: Tier 1 executed control. Only uninstrumented binaries decide the main/v1 paired performance result.
reopens_if: A different profiler configuration has its overhead separately measured or a larger control establishes a tighter estimate.
